# Full-stack example: MongoDB + Backend API + Admin UI + Storefront
#
# Usage:
#   cp docker-compose.full-stack.example.yml docker-compose.yml
#   cp .env.full-stack.example .env
#   # edit secrets in .env
#   docker compose up -d --build
#
# Docs: docs/getting-started.md
#
# Pins: for a more stable deploy, change #develop to a release tag
# (#v<major>.<minor>.<patch>) or use the published GHCR images.

services:
  mongodb:
    image: mongo:7
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - mongodb_data:/data/db
    ports:
      - "27017:27017"
    networks:
      - booking-net

  backend:
    build:
      context: .
      # Or build from GitHub:
      # context: https://github.com/ECCdigital/smart-city-booking-backend.git#develop
    restart: unless-stopped
    env_file:
      - .env
    environment:
      PORT: "8081"
      DB_URL: mongodb://mongodb:27017/booking-manager
      DB_NAME: booking-manager
      FRONTEND_URL: ${FRONTEND_URL:-http://localhost:8080}
      BACKEND_URL: ${BACKEND_URL:-http://localhost:8081}
      NODE_ENV: ${NODE_ENV:-production}
      LOG_LEVEL: ${LOG_LEVEL:-info}
    depends_on:
      - mongodb
    ports:
      - "8081:8081"
    networks:
      - booking-net

  admin:
    build:
      context: https://github.com/ECCdigital/smart-city-booking-vue-app.git#develop
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      VUE_APP_SERVER_BASE_URL: ${BACKEND_URL:-http://localhost:8081}
      VUE_APP_NAME: ${VUE_APP_NAME:-Smart City Booking}
      VUE_APP_IS_PRODUCTION: ${VUE_APP_IS_PRODUCTION:-true}
    depends_on:
      - backend
    ports:
      - "8080:80"
    networks:
      - booking-net

  storefront:
    build:
      context: https://github.com/ECCdigital/smart-city-booking-store-front.git#develop
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      # Server-side BFF → backend on the Docker network (not localhost:8080)
      NUXT_API_BASE_URL: http://backend:8081
      NUXT_USER_BASE_URL: ${NUXT_USER_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:3000}
      NUXT_PUBLIC_USER_BASE_URL: ${NUXT_PUBLIC_USER_BASE_URL:-http://localhost:3000}
      NUXT_ADMIN_BASE_URL: ${FRONTEND_URL:-http://localhost:8080}
      NUXT_PUBLIC_ADMIN_BASE_URL: ${FRONTEND_URL:-http://localhost:8080}
      NUXT_CACHE_ENABLED: ${NUXT_CACHE_ENABLED:-false}
      PORT: "3000"
      NODE_ENV: ${NODE_ENV:-production}
      LOG_LEVEL: ${LOG_LEVEL:-info}
    depends_on:
      - backend
    ports:
      - "3000:3000"
    networks:
      - booking-net

networks:
  booking-net:
    driver: bridge

volumes:
  mongodb_data:
